title: Solving without data in Home: the rebuilt design behind a switch, Build project untouched
request: After the rebuilt no-data design beat the existing one on the practice people, the owner's plan wires the winner into Home behind a switch. The owner's fixed rules: Build project stays exactly as it is, and made-up data is only created after asking the person how it should look and getting their yes.
spec: A switch that is off by default. With it on, the lead agent's tool, the rules-first Home and the route behind the Solve without data button answer a person with no table through the rebuilt design; a need that is not a prediction is answered and not refused; a person who said they have no table is not asked for a file again; nothing creates data; with the switch off nothing changes.
plan: an adapter that gives the rebuilt solution the fields Home's entries and card already read
the three entries take the rebuilt path under the switch
a card on the Home page that draws only the parts that were written
a test that Build project's route, button and code are those of the commit before this work
review, then a test for every finding

decisions.decision: One switch for all three entries, off by default
decisions.why: the held-out people have not been played; the gate, not the builder, turns it on

decisions.decision: With no model, a prediction is answered by the first design's rules and any other need gets a plain note
decisions.why: rules cannot write a business answer, and a model blueprint for a decision is the fault being fixed

decisions.decision: From the rebuilt design the only way to made-up data is the questions and then an approved design
decisions.why: the older offer carries a one-click build, and the owner's rule is to ask first

decisions.decision: Build project is pinned by fingerprints of its route, button, handler and function
decisions.why: a test on history would fail in a shallow checkout; a fingerprint fails on any edit

decisions.decision: The tool's description depends on the switch
decisions.why: the old words tell the model to call it only for a prediction

decisions.decision: The owner turned the rebuilt design on by default with its gate not passed
decisions.why: the gate failed on time alone, every check of quality held on the held-out people, and the design it replaces takes about twenty minutes a person and scored far lower

change: A product adapter for the rebuilt no-data design, a second path in the lead agent's no-data tool and two of its gates, in the rules-first Home's two no-data methods and in the route, a new card and a questions-first message on the Home page, the switch documented and blanked in tests.

findings.defect: With the switch on, a person who asked for simulated data was offered the one-click build with no question asked.
findings.scenario: A draft with no table whose words name nothing to predict and ask for simulated data: the old offer with its build-with-AI button followed the answer, and no question on how the data should look had been asked.
findings.cause: the rebuilt path reused the older offer
findings.fix: Under the switch only the questions are said, with the describe-then-approve action; nothing is offered when there are no questions.

findings.defect: A model that failed on a need that is not a prediction left an empty solution and a refusal to try anything else.
findings.scenario: The architect returned nothing for a why-question: the tool said a solution was ready, the card held one sentence, and the start of any work was refused again.
findings.cause: the plain note was returned in the shape of a solution
findings.fix: No card is shown; the tool tells the lead model to answer in its own words, and the gate tells it to write rather than to call the tool again.

findings.defect: The plain note was saved as the draft's solution and closed Home's question about data.
findings.scenario: Rules-first Home with no model and words that name nothing to predict: the note was stored as the solution and the data plan was marked as settled.
findings.cause: the save ran for every return of the rebuilt path
findings.fix: The note is said as a note and the method returns before anything is saved.

findings.defect: The new gate forbade asking for a file from people who have one.
findings.scenario: A person wrote that they want a model without data leakage and will upload the table in a minute: the gate read no data and sent them to the solution without data.
findings.cause: the stance patterns matched the words anywhere, in everything the person had said
findings.fix: Words such as without data leakage and no data scientist are not a stance, and a latest message saying the table is here now or about to be shared lifts the gate.

findings.defect: A paid request that came back empty was not counted in the case's budget.
findings.scenario: The architect returned nothing for a prediction: the rules answered and the cost of the failed request was dropped.
findings.cause: the fallback's solution did not carry the cost
findings.fix: The cost is carried on the fallback, and the tool's reply says the card's assumed inputs are placeholders.

findings.defect: The route solved without data for a draft that has a table, and ignored typed economics silently.
findings.scenario: The route was called for a draft with a ready table while the switch was on.
findings.cause: the two old refusals were skipped and nothing replaced them
findings.fix: A draft with a ready table is refused with a reason, and the response says typed economics were not used.
findings.open: the route itself has no test with the switch on

measurements.name: The four no-data designs on the sixteen practice people
measurements.gate: none on practice people: the gate is read on the held-out people only
measurements.result: the rebuilt design scored above the existing design on understanding, the solution and the plan, each interval above zero, and slightly below the model alone on the solution and the plan; it stated no number nobody gave; two forbidden things were done
measurements.next: the improved prompt with and without the second reader, then the held-out people once
limits: sixteen people, each once, one judge
practice people, some read by the builder

measurements.name: The gate of the rebuilt no-data design on the eight held-out people
measurements.gate: nodata_gate_v1, pinned before the rebuilt design was run on a live model: every check must hold
measurements.result: understanding and the solution level with the same model alone, the plan 0.38 behind where half a point is allowed, no number nobody gave, nothing forbidden done, accepted for all eight; the time check failed, 374 seconds a person where 300 are allowed
measurements.next: cut the second writing of a draft that only failed the number check; a new held-out set for a new gate
limits: eight people, each once, one judge, means only
the machine was overloaded by a test gate during the run
the held-out people are spent for this gate

outcome: The rebuilt design answers through Home's three entries and is the default since the owner's decision of 2026-11-16; setting the switch to 0 puts the first design back. Its gate failed on time alone and is recorded as failed. Build project is byte-identical to the commit before this work.
lessons: A fallback that returns the shape of a solution will be shown as a solution.
Reusing an older offer can bring back the very click a rule forbids.
A stance read from everything a person ever said must yield to what they say now.
A gate that fails on one check is failed: the default is then the owner's decision, recorded with the check that failed.
risks: With no model a decision still gets no real answer.
The page's new card was not driven in a browser in this package.
The switch is one process-wide setting: the tool's description is fixed when the registry is built.
